title: Studio: one item toolbar — layers, references, history with rollback, audit, source — on every pillar item
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task, verbatim (2026-10-30): 「setup 右侧这套界面，包括看版本历史的，本身就应该属于 studio」 · 「同意新增 2h「Studio 项工具栏」并放在 2a 之前」. ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (P0, child **N-05**) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: L.

**Business reason.** A developer in Studio cannot see an item's layers (code / overlay / effective), what references it, its version history with rollback, its audit trail, or its source — those live only on Setup's item page. Every later customization card (a customized view or flow is revised many times) needs history and rollback where the item is edited; without this the author edits in Studio and goes to Setup to undo.

**Measured** at `d6c0a75f1a`: Setup's item page (`views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`, sheet buttons from line ~2567) opens `LayeredDiff`, the references panel, `ResourceHistoryPage` (expand-diff, per-version rollback with confirm), `AuditPanel`, and `JsonSourceEditor`; `views/studio-design/**` imports none of them (only `AccessExplainPanel`).

**Wanted.**
1. Move `LayeredDiff`, the references panel, `ResourceHistoryPage` (as a sheet), `AuditPanel` and `JsonSourceEditor` to a shared directory under `views/`; Setup's page imports them from there (behaviour unchanged).
2. Studio's item header (`StudioItemHeader.tsx` / right slot) offers the same five on every item of the Data, Interfaces and Automations pillars; history and audit gated by `useCanReadAuthoringTrail` as on Setup; source editable only where the item is.
3. Not carried over: Setup's autosave toggle and `DraftReviewPanel` — Studio keeps its own draft → publish and pending-changes review.
4. Tests: each pillar opens the five; rollback from Studio writes the same history event as from Setup; existing `LayeredDiff.*`, `AuditPanel.*`, `ResourceHistoryPage.*` tests keep their meaning.

**Not here.** Change note on publish and actor display name (N-06, after this); moving the directory and lists (N-26).

**Dedupe.** `"item toolbar" Studio` open+closed: 6 hits, none; `Studio history panel item`: 75 hits, none covering this (#25943 is the copilot right slot — coordinate the slot, not a duplicate).

Links back: #28236, ADR-0146 D1.
